statusLine.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$input = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $model = $input.model.display_name; $dir = Split-Path -Leaf $input.workspace.current_dir; $style = $input.output_style.name; $remaining = $input.context_window.remaining_percentage; if ($remaining -ne $null) { $ctx = \"$([math]::Round($remaining))% left\" } else { $ctx = \"\" }; if ($ctx) { Write-Host \"$model | $dir | $style | $ctx\" -ForegroundColor DarkGray } else { Write-Host \"$model | $dir | $style\" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }"
